author: CNN
description:
At least 100,000 people are expected to attend the flagship “No Kings” protest at the Minnesota State Capitol in St. Paul.

Today’s rally is the first major demonstration since Operation Metro Surge wound down last month and is expected to take on a different tone. Music legend Bruce Springsteen is set to perform at the event.

He will join a star‑studded lineup of cultural icons, including famed folk singer and activist Joan Baez, award-winning actress and activist Jane Fonda, and singer Maggie Rogers. Political leaders are also expected to appear at the event, including Independent Sen. Bernie Sanders, Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison.

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#NoKings #Protest #News
title: Live: ‘No Kings’ flagship protest in MN; Sanders & Springsteen headline

author: CNN
description:
The Strait of Hormuz has been effectively closed by Iran for almost four weeks – throwing global oil markets into chaos – and there is no clear end in sight. US President Donald Trump has touted diplomatic efforts to end Iran's blockade, while also moving to deploy thousands more troops to the Middle East and looking into possible US Navy escorts for oil tankers.

Iran has been laying traps and moving military personnel and air defenses to Kharg Island in preparation for a possible US operation to take control of the island, according to people familiar with US intelligence reporting. Talks between the United States and Iran are ongoing – though both sides are describing things very differently.

Here's a roundup of retired US generals analyzing the fourth week of the Iran war.

0:00 Maj Gen Randy Manner on 4 possible operation options in Iran
4:43 Brig Gen Anderson on a miscalculation of the Iranians' will to fight
8:27 Lt Gen Mark Schwartz on the 82nd Airborne's potential operation
title: Retired generals break down Iran war strategy after week 4
